svg.title: The complete architecture of Gridstore on a small illustrative page: the tracker and data grid, the bitmask of used blocks, and the array of region gap summaries. Keys, value sizes, and free space are illustrative.
svg.desc: Gaps layer, looking for 6 free blocks. Check regions 0 to 1. Check regions 1 to 2. Check regions 2 to 3. Their summaries identify enough space. Scan the selected mask regions to find block 20.

g.text: Mask layer: one bit per block, 1 used, 0 free
Gaps layer: scan adjacent region summaries
Highlighted summaries were checked; outlined blocks fit the value.
